description: JavaScript source file for handling email-related UI interactions in vtiger CRM, including fetching email contents, list view entries, deleting emails, and search functionalities.

methods.name: gotoWebmail
methods.description: Navigates to the webmail interface after checking configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: getEmailContents
methods.description: Fetches and displays the content of a specific email by ID.

methods.name: getListViewEntries_js
methods.description: Loads list view entries for a specified module and URL via AJAX.

methods.name: massDelete
methods.description: Deletes multiple selected emails after user confirmation.

methods.name: DeleteEmail
methods.description: Deletes a single email by ID after user confirmation.

methods.name: Searchfn
methods.description: Performs a search within emails based on selected criteria.

methods.name: getListViewCount
methods.description: Updates the count of list view entries for a module, with AJAX refresh.
